user_request: la tête n'évolue pas et elle est trop foncée pour être lisible en 64px
scope: Five brighter progressively protected default heads; preserve all robe-free bodies exactly using explicit head-region compositing.

jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the exact existing full character to edit. EDIT ONLY HIS SMALL HEAD ABOVE THE NECK. Every body part, neck/collar, shoulder, torso, arm, hand, hip, leg, foot, stance, existing lighting and composition stays unchanged. No robe or cloth. Genuine transparent background, same canvas and complete figure.
Primary request: make this Technomancien HEAD clearly readable when the entire figure is only58 pixels tall in a64×64 game cell, and give this armor rank its own visible head protection stage. Current near-black cranium and mask disappear. Replace them with larger BROAD MID-LIGHT STEEL/ASH-GREY head planes around a restrained dark mechanical face inset. The crown, temple and cheek shapes must be clearly lighter than the dark ground, WITHOUT glow. About two or three calm value planes, not tiny silver edge lines. One small amber optic on viewer left, bronze lower-face identity may remain. No flesh, skull, human lips or teeth.
Do not enlarge the head: same normal compact height, small human proportion, top at same height, short neck seated in shoulders. Roughly8–10 native pixels high total including head armor, no tall helmet, crest, horns, fin, halo, crown or giant dome. Armor advancement changes the COVERAGE and simple SHAPE of the small head shell, not its scale. Do not make a detailed portrait.
Critical readability: big quiet pale steel masses, a clearly separated dark optic/face recess and simple jaw silhouette; NO tiny rivets, vents, dots, filigree, texture, cables, emblems or multiple glow points. Keep single amber optic only. No religious markings or recognizable franchise design. Head belongs to torso's default appearance; this is not a separate item sheet.
Keep every pixel below the head identical. Do NOT brighten, repaint or redesign any armor on the body, including the neck collar. No text, extra objects or background.
HEAD STAGE1/5, VERY LIGHT: BARE mechanical head, no external helmet. A smooth exposed MID-LIGHT brushed-steel cranium and light temple frame, narrower dark face recess around the single amber optic and a simple bronze chin/jaw. No added cheek armor, chin guard or enclosed helmet. The exposed steel head must be as readable as the body's small light guards. One clean compact robotic skull shape.
